pbesol.pooling: one hash-selected record per reduced composition

required_before_label_opening: the committed panel freeze matches its canonical digest
all 24 candidate checkpoints match their sealed completion records
both released reference checkpoints match their published hashes
every checkpoint has exactly one finite prediction for every frozen structure
prediction outputs and the complete prediction manifest are hashed

checkpoint_scoring.normalization_reference: the exact frozen training subset for each candidate-budget arm
checkpoint_scoring.composite_score: z(minimum-frequency prediction) + 0.5 * z(threshold-score mean) + 0.2 * z(pair-geometry score)

outcome_source.workflow: Pheasy compressive-sensing harmonic phonons in atomate2

primary: best_candidate_accuracy at each budget using two-seed mean Top-100 stable rate
mean allocation regret in Top-100 stable-rate points
pairwise agreement with the frozen complete order
supporting: utility relative to the starting checkpoint
metrics.ties: half credit for pairwise ties; tied predicted winners share their observed utility

frozen_candidate_prediction.source: complete two-seed ordering observed on the earlier PBE panel

scope.claim: transfer to new PBEsol outcomes and a new DFT workflow, not to structures wholly unseen by the starting model
